# Is your AI system prohibited, high-risk, or only a transparency case under the EU AI Act?

> Free EU AI Act risk checker: tick what your AI system does and your role to see whether it is prohibited, high-risk, or only has transparency duties under Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, with the Articles, your duties and the dates. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
